Mike R.: Quick Q — I just got married and want to add my partner's parent (they're my child's step-parent) to medical. Is that a mid‑year addition? What docs do you need?

Asha (People Ops): Congrats Mike! :tada: Two quick clarifying q's — is the person a legal dependent (on your taxes) or do you have guardianship/court docs? Adding an unrelated adult is handled differently.

Mike R.: They are my spouse's parent, not on my taxes currently. We help with most of their living expenses but no formal guardianship.

Asha (People Ops): OK — typically to add an adult you need one of the following to meet eligibility for dependent adult coverage:
- Court-appointed guardianship or power of attorney naming you as caregiver
- Proof they are claimed as a dependent on your or your spouse's most recent tax return (Form 1040)
- A combination of 3 of: shared lease/mortgage, joint bank statements, utility bills, statements showing you provide >50% support
If none of those apply we can't add them as a dependent for medical.

Max (Benefits Ops): Another note — if they’re eligible as a dependent under the plan, the QLE window for marriage is 30 days from the date of marriage to submit docs. Enrollment effective date depends on carrier: most often first of the next month after approval, sometimes retro to the QLE date if carrier allows.

Lina (Payroll): Payroll/proration: once Benefits approves, we will update deductions. If effective date is retro, we do a one-time adjustment on the next payroll to catch up. If effective date is future, deductions begin on the first payroll after that date. Expect 1 payroll cycle for changes to appear.

Mike R.: Thanks — if I upload tax return + shared lease + bank statement will that usually be enough? Also any special handling for non-US docs (they're from outside US)?

Asha (People Ops): That should be fine — we need them translated to English and notarized if not in English. For tax returns, an official copy or screenshot of e-file confirmation is OK. Please redact SSNs.

Max (Benefits Ops): To speed things up, upload via the secure benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.example/upload — choose "Dependent Verification" and include a short note with the QLE date.

Mike R.: Uploaded a PDF bundle just now. File name: "mike-stepparent-proofs.pdf"

Benefits Bot: Upload received from Mike R. — File ID: upload_1764123490 — Status: awaiting manual review.

Asha (People Ops): Got it — I'll review and DM if anything else is needed. If approved, Max will trigger enrollment and Lina will handle payroll. :thumbsup: 

Lina (Payroll): FYI payroll team needs approval email from benefits ops and the effective date. If anyone wants a heads-up when adjustment posts, ping me.

Mike R.: Perfect, thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick help!

Asha (People Ops): You're welcome — will update thread when next steps complete.
